trends.name: Iran-US Escalation & Tech Targeting
trends.summary: Iran's IRGC issued direct threats to target 18 US technology companies (Nvidia, Apple, Microsoft, Google, Intel, Oracle, Tesla, Meta, IBM) starting April 1st in retaliation for 'targeted assassinations.' This represents acute geopolitical risk for mega-cap tech stocks and potential supply chain disruption. Trump indicated the Iran war won't last much longer, creating uncertainty around conflict resolution and sanctions.

trends.name: Strait of Hormuz Control & Oil Markets
trends.summary: Trump urged other nations to 'take' the Strait of Hormuz while stating it will 'automatically open,' signaling potential de-escalation in Middle East tensions. Iran's presidency disputed US commitment to diplomacy and blamed US-Zionist actions for strait tensions. This directly impacts crude oil pricing, shipping costs, and broader commodity inflation expectations.

trends.name: Gold's Worst Month Since 2008
trends.summary: Gold has tracked its biggest monthly drop since the 2008 financial crisis, suggesting weakening safe-haven demand and potential shift in investor risk appetite. This coincides with hard asset reassessment and signals changing macro expectations. The decline reflects confidence in de-escalation narratives and potential Fed policy shifts.

trends.name: Oracle's AI Pivot & Mass Layoffs
trends.summary: Oracle is cutting thousands of employees while ramping massive AI spending, signaling aggressive pivot toward agentic AI and automation. This reflects broader enterprise software restructuring and raises questions about near-term earnings drag versus long-term AI positioning. Relevant to ServiceNow's similar AI trajectory and enterprise software sector rotation.

trends.name: Lilly's $7.8B Centessa Acquisition
trends.summary: Eli Lilly announced acquisition of Centessa for up to $7.8 billion to gain experimental sleep disorder drug pipeline. Represents major pharma M&A activity and Lilly's continued aggressive growth strategy in neuroscience. Follows broader pharma consolidation trend alongside Gilead's M&A activity.

trends.name: ServiceNow Stock Collapse & AI Narrative
trends.summary: ServiceNow experiencing worst quarter on record despite analyst positioning as 'Strong Bet On Agentic AI.' Stock weakness contradicts bullish AI thesis, suggesting valuation reset and investor skepticism on execution. Signals potential rotation away from high-multiple SaaS names despite AI positioning.

trends.name: Nike Earnings & Consumer Spending Signals
trends.summary: Nike earnings report after-hours provides key read on consumer health and discretionary spending amid uncertain macro backdrop. Results will inform broader apparel sector and consumer staples outlook. Comes amid mixed signals on inflation and wage pressures affecting retail.

trends.name: US Corn & Crop Planting Revisions
trends.summary: USDA quarterly reports show significant revisions to corn, soybean, wheat, and cotton planting intentions, with corn slightly above estimates but wheat and cotton lower. Corn and soybean stocks below prior year, affecting global commodity pricing and agricultural sector outlook. Critical for inflation expectations and food inflation trends.

trends.name: Fed Rate Cut Expectations & Oil Dynamics
trends.summary: $4/gallon gas prices unlikely to trigger Fed rate hikes and could paradoxically lead to rate cuts if inflation narrative shifts. Oil rally resilience suggests energy security concerns offset deflationary gas price impacts. Impacts Fed's policy path and equity valuations broadly.

trends.name: Snap's Activist Campaign & Stock Rebound
trends.summary: Activist investor Irenic Capital pushing for changes at Snap to boost stock 7x, with stock climbing 13% on activism catalyst. Represents consumer tech turnaround narrative and activist-driven value unlocking. Signals broader opportunities in underperforming growth tech names.

trends.name: Visa Valuation Reset & Compounding Opportunity
trends.summary: Visa positioned as shift from defensive to compounding opportunity after significant valuation reset. Payment processor strength in digital economy and secular growth trends intact despite macro concerns. Represents rotation into quality compounders at attractive valuations.

trends.name: Whistleblower Portal & Healthcare Fraud Crackdown
trends.summary: Treasury Department unveils whistleblower portal targeting transnational Medicare and Medicaid fraud rings. Signals increased regulatory scrutiny on healthcare spending and fraud, affecting healthcare provider margins and reimbursement rates. Relevant to managed care and healthcare services sector outlook.
